name: @devos/api
description: DevOS API (M1.2): NestJS, Tailscale identity, 12-hour session, CSRF, security headers, request-ID JSON logs, OpenAPI contract.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @devos/policy --filter @devos/analyst --filter @devos/card-batch --filter @devos/run-engine --filter @devos/linear-sync run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:db: pnpm --filter @devos/policy --filter @devos/analyst --filter @devos/card-batch run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "test-db/*.test.mjs"
